$comment: Museum works on other products, one hidden Shopify Draft per artwork per family (app/lib/artProductCatalog.ts). collections[] holds the owner-approved prices and Prodigi SKUs per print-catalog collection; products[] is written by `npm run product -- prepare <collection> --families` (assets), `stage … --families --apply` (Shopify ids), `mapped … --family <f>` and `release`. Never add these works to the live studio extension products.

collections.copy: Part of Floating World, a Clara Mendes selection of Edo-period Japanese woodblock prints from museum open-access collections.

framed-print.providerSettings: Natural classic frame, 200gsm Enhanced Matte Art paper, no mount, Perspex glazing; print area 100%, position 0/0, no Prodigi border; quality Excellent; Standard shipping; fulfilled automatically

canvas.providerSettings: 38 mm bar, MirrorWrap; print area 100%, position 0/0; quality as rated (the live canvas files rate Acceptable); Standard shipping; fulfilled automatically

greeting-card.providerSettings: Four-panel 6117×2161 file at 100%, position 0/0 (front panel second from left, as the live cards); Budget shipping (letter post); fulfilled automatically

postcard.providerSettings: Two-sided 4323×1559 file at 100%, position 0/0 (artwork on the right half, as the live postcards); Budget shipping (letter post); fulfilled automatically

phone-case.providerSettings: Not channel-mapped: the orders/paid webhook sends the deployed 4:5 file to the Prodigi API with sizing fillPrintArea, one Prodigi SKU per device from data/art-tough-phone-case.json

hanger-print.providerSettings: Hanger colour from the variant (black, white or natural oak); print area 100%, position 0/0, no Prodigi border; Standard shipping; fulfilled automatically. The files keep 15 mm under each wooden strip.

acrylic-print.providerSettings: 10 mm high-gloss acrylic panel; print area 100%, position 0/0, no Prodigi border; Standard shipping; fulfilled automatically

metal-print.providerSettings: Dibond, matt finish; print area 100%, position 0/0, no Prodigi border; Standard shipping; fulfilled automatically. Sent from the UK or US, not the EU (owner kept it, 16 Oct 2026)

printful-mug.providerSettings: White Glossy Mug 11 oz; the 2700×1050 file fills the 9 × 3.5 in print area

cushion.providerSku: Printful 215 Premium Pillow Case (cover) / 214 Premium Pillow (with insert)
cushion.providerSettings: The same 3300×3300 file on the front and the back; Printful scales it to 18 in

blanket.providerSettings: The 7500×9000 file fills the 50 × 60 in print area (wide works are already turned)
